ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: REGEX( Phone , "(?=.*[a-zA-Z]).*$") || REGEX( AssistantPhone , "(?=.*[a-zA-Z]).*$") || REGEX( HomePhone , "(?=.*[a-zA-Z]).*$") || REGEX( OtherPhone , "(?=.*[a-zA-Z]).*$") || REGEX( MobilePhone , "(?=.*[a-zA-Z]).*$")
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Do not use letters in Phone and Mobile fields.
